artworks.title: Flowering Bush and Desert Plants
artworks.artist: American 19th Century after John Frederick Kensett
artworks.medium: graphite with gouache on wove paper
artworks.creditLine: Corcoran Collection (Museum Purchase, Membership Association, 1949)
artworks.description: The image is a ground-level view depicted in a sketch-like pencil drawing. There is no visible horizon line. The composition focuses on plants across a flat expanse of ground. Details of wildflowers and grass clumps are rendered with fine strokes, giving a delicate, textured appearance. The color palette is muted, consisting of the paper's beige tone and the natural gray of the pencil. The background shows more tufts of grass with less detail than the foreground plants.

artworks.title: Weser
artworks.medium: graphite with gouache on wove paper
artworks.creditLine: Corcoran Collection (Museum Purchase, Membership Association Fund, 1949)
artworks.description: The image shows a mountainous landscape with a low horizon line, depicting an extensive terrain. The mountains span the horizon, rising sharply on each side. In the center, a valley is enclosed by the mountains. The drawing is in light pencil sketches, creating an airy look. Delicate, even strokes outline the mountains, valleys, and sparse vegetation. The subdued color palette includes shades of grey with soft whites and light blush tints. The foreground is mostly barren with sparse vegetation, leading the eye towards detailed mountain peaks in the distance.

artworks.title: William Wilson Corcoran
artworks.medium: pen, brush, and black ink with gouache on wove paper mounted to board
artworks.creditLine: Corcoran Collection
artworks.description: The image shows an elderly man standing upright and holding a hat in his left hand. He has a stern expression and distinct facial features, including a broad forehead, deep-set eyes, and a prominent nose. He is dressed in a formal suit with a coat, waistcoat, and trousers. In his right hand, he holds a walking stick. The background is mostly blank with some shading and sketchy lines around the figure.

artworks.title: Figures by the Shore
artworks.medium: graphite on wove paper
artworks.creditLine: Corcoran Collection (Gift of J. William Middendorf, II, 1977)
artworks.description: The point of view in this drawing is at eye level, offering a landscape scene. The horizon is towards the upper third of the image and is subtly defined, providing a sense of depth. In the distance, there are two silhouetted figures close to each other. Toward the left, there are bushes and a few trees with branches extending upwards, including one large tree leaning towards the right. The brushstrokes are delicate and soft, likely charcoal or pencil, providing a gentle texture to the foliage and the ground. The color palette is monochromatic, primarily shades of gray, enhancing the tranquil quality of the scene.

artworks.title: Study for "White Mountains from North Conway, New Hampshire" [recto]
artworks.medium: graphite with gouache on blue, ruled wove paper
artworks.creditLine: Corcoran Collection (Museum Purchase, 1964)
artworks.description: The drawing shows a seated figure wearing a hat, looking into the distance. This creates depth as the viewer follows the figure's gaze over a landscape. The horizon is high in the image, enhancing the vista beyond the figure. The pencil sketch uses controlled lines and shading to depict the figure and the terrain. The color palette is monochromatic, with pencil on paper providing a soft visual effect. The sketch includes grass and rock formations near the figure, with some trees in the distance.

artworks.title: Chicken Vendors [recto]
artworks.medium: brush and black ink, watercolor, gouache, charcoal, and graphite on wove paper
artworks.creditLine: Corcoran Collection (Museum Purchase, 1949)
artworks.description: The image is an abstract artwork with bold, sweeping lines and shapes that create discernible figures and objects. Curved lines resemble human figures wearing broad hats and donkeys. The background has dark, earthy tones suggesting a market scene. One figure with a large hat appears active, surrounded by other figures and animals in motion. Elements hint at rural life and commerce with stylized patterns and animal forms.

artworks.title: Emblem of the United States of America
artworks.medium: engraving in black on laid paper
artworks.creditLine: Corcoran Collection (Museum Purchase, Mary E. Maxwell Fund, 1955)
artworks.description: This is a drawing of an allegorical emblem. The image depicts a seated figure holding a staff and a branch, surrounded by a border of linked circles with stars. The figure is draped in classical robes and is sitting on a large spherical object, with a shield resting beside them and various items, including an open book and anchor, placed in the foreground. The composition is finely detailed, with the folds of the robes, the texture of the woven sphere, and the pattern on the shield rendered with delicate linework. The border adds a decorative element, reinforcing the emblematic theme of the piece. The inscription at the bottom reads, "Emblem of the United States of America. Peace with all Nations, Partiality to none."

artworks.title: Memorial for George Washington
artworks.artist: Enoch G. Gridley, after John Coles, Jr.
artworks.medium: engraving and stipple etching in black on wove paper
artworks.creditLine: Corcoran Collection (Museum Purchase, Mary E. Maxwell Fund, 1953)
artworks.description: The image depicts various figures in a symbolic illustration. A central pedestal showcases a portrait of a man, potentially George Washington, labeled "Pater Patriae." Surrounding the portrait are allegorical figures, including cherubs and a female figure near a canon and a helmeted warrior's head. A soldier in uniform stands beside them. The background features a rounded arch and sky. An inscription below the pedestal honors George Washington.

artworks.title: Baptism
artworks.medium: etching
artworks.creditLine: Corcoran Collection (Museum Purchase, Mary E. Maxwell Fund, 1927)
artworks.description: The image depicts a detailed drawing of three individuals from the waist up, arranged in a staggered formation. The central figure is a woman facing slightly downward with her eyes closed, adorned with a cloth covering her head. She wears a dark cloak fastened at the neck with a hand near her chest. To her left is a man in partial profile also looking down, wearing a head covering and simple garment. On the right is another man in profile with a prominent nose and facial hair, wearing a dark cloak and hands clasped together. The background features vertical lines suggesting an architectural setting, fading into a dark void behind them.

artworks.title: Horse
artworks.medium: graphite on wove paper
artworks.creditLine: Corcoran Collection (Gift of Rear Admiral E.H.C. Leutze, son of the artist, 1917)
artworks.description: This is an illustration of a horse with a saddle. The drawing shows a standing horse facing right, equipped with a saddle. The horse is depicted realistically, with detailed attention to its anatomy and stance. The saddle is placed on the horse, with visible stirrups. The drawing uses fine lines and shading to highlight the horse's body and the saddle's details, creating a sense of depth and texture. The empty space around the horse accentuates the intricate pencil work on the main subject.

artworks.title: Sweet Briar
artworks.medium: watercolor and graphite on wove paper
artworks.creditLine: Corcoran Collection (Museum Purchase through a gift of Philip Alexius de Laszlo, 1980)
artworks.description: The image shows a landscape with a house to the right, distant trees on the horizon, and another building in the background. In the foreground, there are three tall trees framing the scene, with two adults and a child under their shade. The painting is detailed with delicate brushstrokes, creating a soft texture. The color palette consists of greens, browns, blues, whites, and grays, evoking a calm atmosphere. A few clouds are scattered in the sky above.

artworks.title: En train de ...confectionner quelques
artworks.medium: lithograph
artworks.creditLine: Corcoran Collection (Gift of Dr. Armand Hammer, 1983)
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a seated figure engaged in sewing. The figure is sewing with needle and thread, while sitting on a cloth-covered surface. On the right, there are objects hanging on the wall. The drawing portrays a historical and slightly dramatic atmosphere.

artworks.title: At Catskill, Greene County, New York
artworks.medium: watercolor and gouache with pen and black ink over graphite on wove paper mounted to wove paper
artworks.creditLine: Corcoran Collection (Museum Purchase through a gift of Rudolph Max Kauffmann, 1955)
artworks.description: The image shows a landscape with a distant horizon under a sky painted in soft tones of beige and grey. Smooth brushstrokes create transitions between elements. In the foreground, a man stands next to a child on rocky terrain, flanked by trees with autumnal leaves. A clearing leads to a line of trees in the background, blending into misty surroundings. The color palette is earthy and muted, with browns, greens, and grey-blues.

artworks.title: Studies of a Boy on a Ladder
artworks.medium: graphite on wove paper
artworks.creditLine: Corcoran Collection (Gift of J. William Middendorf, II, 1977)
artworks.description: The image depicts two full-body sketches of a person on a ladder. The person is seated sideways on the ladder, holding onto a rung for support. Their facial features are outlined in a side profile view, and they wear a brimmed hat, a buttoned top, and loose-fitting pants. There are no visible jewelry or objects in their hands. The background includes pencil grid lines and outlines of the ladder structure against a plain backdrop.

artworks.title: Man at a Doorway
artworks.medium: ink wash over graphite on wove paper
artworks.creditLine: Corcoran Collection (Gift of J. William Middendorf, II, 1977)
artworks.description: The image shows a drawing of a man from his waist up. He is positioned leaning in from the right edge, with his head turned towards the viewer. The man has a broad smile, large eyes, short curly hair, and is wearing a dark suit over a light-colored shirt with a visible lapel. His right arm is resting on the edge of the frame. The background is plain and off-white, emphasizing the man as the main focal point.

artworks.title: By the Old Oak Trees
artworks.medium: graphite on wove paper
artworks.creditLine: Corcoran Collection (Gift of J. William Middendorf, II, 1977)
artworks.description: The image shows a woodland scene with grand trees dominating the composition. Delicate pencil strokes convey the trees' texture and foliage. Two figures are depicted, one standing and the other sitting. In the distance, more trees and a small building are visible. The monochromatic image uses soft gray against beige, highlighting the natural forms and details of the scene.

artworks.title: A Gleamy Effect—Hollidaysburg, Pennsylvania
artworks.medium: watercolor and gouache over graphite on wove paper
artworks.creditLine: Corcoran Collection (Museum Purchase, 1948)
artworks.description: The image shows a rural landscape from an elevated angle. The horizon features blue hills and a pale sky with hints of clouds and sunlight. In the foreground, a wagon pulled by two animals travels on a dirt path leading to a small settlement. Fields of gold, houses, and a tall tree with few leaves are also visible. The color palette is warm with blue accents in the background.

artworks.title: Une Descente en parachute
artworks.medium: lithograph
artworks.creditLine: Corcoran Collection (Gift of Dr. Armand Hammer, 1983)
artworks.description: The image shows a caricature of a person sitting in a basket suspended from a parachute. The character has exaggerated facial features, is dressed in dark clothing, and a floating top hat beside them. The background features a cityscape with recognizable structures such as an obelisk and rooftops. Text is present at the top and bottom of the image.

artworks.title: Glimpse of the Palazzo Doria, Genova
artworks.medium: transparent and opaque watercolor over graphite on wove paper
artworks.creditLine: Corcoran Collection (Gift of Mrs. Armistead Peter III [Caroline Ogden-Jones Peter], 1976)
artworks.description: The point of view in this image is an eye-level view capturing an architectural scene. The horizon is high in the frame, showing buildings and a tower in the distance. Several structures, including a prominent tower with a pointed roof, are visible against a soft, pale sky. The artwork features controlled brushstrokes detailing the architecture. The color palette includes earthy beiges and browns for the buildings, lush greens for vegetation, and muted tones for the sky. Architectural details, such as stone carvings on an arched gateway, are prominent. Green foliage rises beyond this, and rooftops and walls ascend a hillside further away, adding depth to the image.

artworks.title: Peasant
artworks.medium: pen and black ink on wove paper
artworks.creditLine: Corcoran Collection (Gift of J. William Middendorf, II, 1977)
artworks.description: The image shows a man standing, holding a long pole. He has a mustache and wears a hat, a light shirt, and trousers with rolled-up sleeves. The background features sketchy lines indicating a textured surface.

artworks.title: Studies of Farmers Shucking Corn
artworks.medium: graphite, pen and black ink, and wash on wove paper
artworks.creditLine: Corcoran Collection (Gift of J. William Middendorf, II, 1977)
artworks.description: The image features two sketched scenes on a textured, beige sheet. On the right side, within a square frame, two figures are drawn. One figure wears a hat and sits in profile on a surface with debris. Beside them, another figure is seated in a relaxed posture. The surroundings suggest an indoor setting with a large opening or window showing an abstract landscape. On the left, a fainter sketch shows another figure amid debris, with less detail. The background is the plain beige texture of the paper. No specific details about jewelry or objects held are included.

artworks.title: Head of a Man
artworks.medium: graphite with gouache on gray wove paper
artworks.creditLine: Corcoran Collection (Gift of J. William Middendorf, II, 1977)
artworks.description: The image is a head-and-shoulders portrait of an older man captured in profile. The man's facial features include visible wrinkles, lines, and a prominent nose. His hair is short and thinning, appearing to be receding slightly at the forehead. He is dressed in a dark-colored shirt and there are no visible accessories. The background is plain and monochromatic with a textured gray material.

artworks.title: Studies of a Man and Horse Cart
artworks.medium: watercolor and graphite on gray laid paper
artworks.creditLine: Corcoran Collection (Gift of J. William Middendorf, II, 1977)
artworks.description: Two male figures and a horse are depicted in the image. The upper figure is standing upright and viewed from a side angle. He wears a hat, has sideburns, a light-colored shirt, a vest, and light-colored trousers. He stands on another person, who is supporting him. The lower figure sits on a cart that is being drawn by a donkey. The lower figure wears a vest, his legs are stretched forward, and he appears to be holding reins. The background is plain with sketch lines indicating parts of a cart and the donkey.

artworks.title: Studies of a Well and Wooden Trough
artworks.medium: watercolor and gouache over graphite on wove paper
artworks.creditLine: Corcoran Collection (Gift of J. William Middendorf, II, 1977)
artworks.description: There is a large, rustic wooden structure to the left, resembling a tall crate or makeshift cabinet, with a small hatch or opening on one side and a cylindrical object poking out from the top. In front of this structure, on the ground, there are two shallow wooden troughs or containers. The color palette consists of muted earthy tones including browns, grays, and hints of yellow, with an overall weathered and aged appearance. The wooden structure is positioned to the left, occupying the majority of the left side of the image, while the two troughs are placed in a linear arrangement from left to right on the lower right side of the image. Some lightly sketched and painted tools or implements can be seen in the background on the right.
